headline.en: Link previews in browser panes, yearly Pro and fewer crashes

title.en: See where a link goes before you click

summary.en: Browser panes show a link's address at the bottom left when you hover it. Turn it off with browser.showLinkHoverURL in cmux.json.

title.en: Keep workspace colors as you chose them in dark mode

summary.en: Set workspaceColors.brightenInDarkMode to false in cmux.json, and dark mode shows your workspace colors exactly as you picked them.
Pro can be billed yearly for $480, which is $40 a month and 20% less than monthly billing.

title.en: Faster search in Settings and Keyboard Shortcuts

summary.en: Results in Settings and Keyboard Shortcuts now keep up while you type, even with long lists.

title.en: A clear message when the CLI and the app differ

summary.en: When the running app does not support a cmux command, the CLI now explains the version mismatch and how to fix it.

title.en: No crash when you close a terminal

summary.en: cmux no longer crashes when you close a terminal while it redraws, and restored scrollback no longer starts with raw escape codes.
Cmd-Y opens New Machine without crashing, and its Base, Size and Network menus line up again.
